title: 3dmaskdump
description: Outputs voxel values from AFNI datasets satisfying mask criteria to an ASCII file.

input_files.description: Input datasets to dump voxel values
input_files.title: Input datasets

mask_dataset.description: Use the dataset as a mask. Only voxels with nonzero values in the mask will be printed from the input dataset.
mask_dataset.title: Mask dataset

mask_range.description: Further restrict the voxels from mask dataset to those mask values between 'a' and 'b' (inclusive).
mask_range.title: Mask range

output_index.description: Write out the dataset index values.
output_index.title: Output index values

output_noijk.description: Do not write out the i,j,k values.
output_noijk.title: Exclude i,j,k values

output_xyz.description: Write the x,y,z coordinates from the first input dataset at the start of each output line.
output_xyz.title: Output x,y,z coordinates

calc_mask_opts.description: Execute options enclosed as a 3dcalc-like program to produce a mask from the resulting 3D brick.
calc_mask_opts.title: 3dcalc-like mask options

xbox_coords.description: Put a 'mask' at dataset coordinates 'x y z' mm.
xbox_coords.title: Dataset coordinates for mask

dbox_coords.description: Put a 'mask' at RAI/DICOM coordinates of 'x y z' mm.
dbox_coords.title: RAI/DICOM coordinates for mask

nbox_coords.description: Put a 'mask' at LPI/SPM coordinates of 'x y z' mm.
nbox_coords.title: LPI/SPM coordinates for mask

ibox_coords.description: Put a 'mask' at voxel indexes 'i j k'.
ibox_coords.title: Voxel indexes for mask

xball_coords.description: Put a ball (sphere) mask at dataset coordinates (x,y,z) with radius r.
xball_coords.title: Coordinates and radius for ball mask

dball_coords.description: Put a ball (sphere) mask at RAI/DICOM coordinates (x,y,z) with radius r.
dball_coords.title: RAI/DICOM Coordinates and radius for ball mask

nball_coords.description: Put a ball (sphere) mask at LPI/SPM coordinates (x,y,z) with radius r.
nball_coords.title: LPI/SPM Coordinates and radius for ball mask

nozero_output.description: Skip output of any voxel where all the data values are zero.
nozero_output.title: Exclude zero values

random_voxels.description: Keep only N_RAND randomly selected voxels from what would have been the output.
random_voxels.title: Number of random voxels

random_seed.description: Seed the random number generator with SEED.
random_seed.title: Random seed

output_niml.description: Output data in the XML/NIML format compatible with input back to AFNI via the READ_NIML_FILE command.
output_niml.title: NIML format output

quiet_mode.description: Do not print progress messages to stderr.
quiet_mode.title: Quiet mode
